players.product: LIDE laser-induced deep etching for glass-core substrates and through-glass vias (TGV)

quarterly_data.quarter: LPKF Laser & Electronics press release: Leading Asian advanced semiconductor packaging manufacturer (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LPKF received a letter of intent (LOI) to purchase NEXAR LIDE systems from an unnamed Asian advanced packaging manufacturer (described by LPKF as leading) for the production ramp-up of glass substrates. The customer already operates an LPKF system and has fully qualified the LIDE (Laser Induced Deep Etching) technology; with the follow-on orders under the LOI it is preparing the ramp-up of its first glass substrate production facility for high-performance advanced packaging. LOI volume is in the mid-single-digit million euro range, with the orders expected shortly. CEO Klaus Fiedler said LPKF expects the project to be followed by additional orders.
quarterly_data.figure: LOI volume in the mid-single-digit million euro range; orders expected shortly

quarterly_data.quarter: LPKF Laser & Electronics press release: Leading Asian advanced semiconductor packaging manufacturer (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Based on industry studies and market-analyst forecasts, LPKF estimates the total addressable market for its glass processing solutions at around EUR 1.7 billion by 2030, with further structural growth expected beyond 2030. LPKF says it is reviewing options to strengthen its global presence and operational capabilities and, depending on future business developments and market conditions, is evaluating financing alternatives including a potential equity raise.
quarterly_data.figure: glass processing TAM around EUR 1.7 billion by 2030 (company estimate); potential equity raise under evaluation
